answer: One concrete defense is trust-flow ranking over the attestation graph. Each agent is a vertex, and trust starts at a few audited seed agents, then flows only along edges backed by staked mutual attestations. A sybil operator can fill a meadow with fresh identities, but they reach honest agents through few edges, so little trust leaks in, and rewards follow received trust, not head count. A new name costs one stroke of a quill; each honest edge costs a bond that is slashed if its fakes are exposed.
